title: raw file
description: A file of the design exactly as it is on disk, from describe --raw, with the sum a write over it names, so a reader can show or edit the bytes on disk and write them back over that version only. A layout.yml still at version 1 is refused with old_form, saying to run e-designer migrate layout.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always RawFile, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

text.description: The file's bytes as text, comments and all, so an editor shows what is on disk and not a reading of it.

path.description: The file's path in the design, with / between folders, such as design.yml or block/CMP-STORE.yml, never absolute and never with . or .. as a step, so a reader names the same file back and no folder of the machine it ran on is given away.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the file's bytes as read, in hex; a write over the file names it with --replaces, so a file that changed meanwhile is not written over.
